class.name: MetaHumanRig
class.brief_description: Evaluates a MetaHuman's body and face rigs and poses the skeleton.
class.description: Evaluates a MetaHuman's rigs with RigLogic, Epic's rig evaluator (from OpenRigLogic), and poses its [Skeleton3D] parent, after animation and before skinning. The body rig adds the correctives (RBF, twist and swing helper joints) that the main joints' pose calls for: animate the skeleton's main joints as usual and the helpers follow. The face rig turns face controls into the face joints. Each rig writes only the joints that move at its current LOD, and skips its evaluation when its inputs did not change. Face controls are properties under [code]expressions/[/code] (the raw [code]CTRL_expressions.*[/code] controls, which Unreal's face animation curves, ARKit and Live Link drive) and [code]face_board/[/code] (the face board controls), so animation tracks can key them. [member control_mode] decides which set drives the face. The MetaHuman importer ([code].dna[/code] files) creates this node with both rigs set up.

method.name: get_control
method.description: Returns the value of the face control [param name], an expression ([code]CTRL_expressions.jawOpen[/code]) or a face board control ([code]CTRL_C_jaw.ty[/code]).

method.name: get_control_names
method.description: Returns the names of the face controls of the current [member control_mode]. Driver inputs ([code]head.qx[/code], ...) are not among them: the rig reads those from the skeleton.

method.name: get_current_body_lod
method.description: Returns the LOD the body rig was last evaluated at, or [code]-1[/code] before its first evaluation.

method.name: get_current_face_lod
method.description: Returns the LOD the face rig was last evaluated at, or [code]-1[/code] before its first evaluation.

method.name: reset_controls
method.description: Sets every face control back to [code]0[/code].

method.name: set_control
method.description: Sets the face control [param name] to [param value]. Expressions range from [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code].

members.member: The body rig. Its raw controls are the rotations of driver joints such as [code]upperarm_l[/code], read from the skeleton.
The body rig's LOD, or [code]-1[/code] to pick it from [member body_lod_distances] and the distance to the current camera.

With [member body_lod] at [code]-1[/code], the camera distance below which each LOD is used: LOD [code]i[/code] up to [code]body_lod_distances[i][/code], the last LOD beyond. The importer matches these to the body meshes' visibility ranges.
Which face controls drive the face rig.
The face rig. Setting it lists its controls as properties.
The face rig's LOD, or [code]-1[/code] to pick it from [member face_lod_distances] and the distance to the current camera.
With [member face_lod] at [code]-1[/code], the camera distance below which each LOD is used. The importer matches these to the head meshes' visibility ranges.

constants.constant: The raw expression controls ([code]expressions/*[/code]) drive the face.
The face board controls ([code]face_board/*[/code]) drive the face; the rig maps them to expressions.
